title: DrawingObject
description: A DDL object. Version 0.1.0. PRD §7.5 FR-40, §5A.3 hooks 1 and 3, FR-160–163. The object-class vocabulary is pack data (profiles), not part of the contract.

id.description: Stable across revisions; never reused for a different element.

class.description: Object class from the pack vocabulary, e.g. masonry, insulation, cavity, membrane, coping, dpc, upstand, deck, room, plot_boundary.

material_id.description: Key into the DDL `materials` list. Never free text (5A.3 hook 1).

level.description: Storey id or datum-relative level; storeys and datum are project data (5A.3 hook 2).

properties.description: Further typed values for the class (e.g. fall_ratio, upstand_height, span). Keys come from the pack vocabulary.

field_provenance.description: Per-field provenance where a field's source differs from the object's (e.g. the user named the material but the thickness was inferred).

rule_refs.description: Rule ids that apply to this object.

status.description: Existing vs proposed; used by narration (FR-132) and plans.

geometry.description: Coordinates are in the drawing's units, in the drawing's local frame (site plans: the CRS in `site`).

along.description: layer_band: the path a build-up layer follows, as object ids or a polyline.

material.description: A material referenced by `material_id`. Construction defaults supply most materials (FR-06–09); a user statement overrides and becomes source: user.

name.description: Plain name as it appears in annotations and schedules.

category.description: Pack vocabulary, e.g. masonry, insulation, membrane, metal, stone, render, glazing, roofing_sheet, tile.

spec.description: Specification text as supplied, e.g. "PIR board, foil faced".

sample_asset_id.description: User-uploaded sample photo (FR-160), used only within this material's region mask (FR-161).

manufacturer_product.description: Only from a signed product profile (FR-162).

pbr_asset_id.description: Stage 3 Studio renders (FR-123). Null until then.

material.$comment: basis must agree with what is present (trust rule 11a): manufacturer_texture needs a signed manufacturer_product with a texture; sample_photo needs sample_asset_id; colour_code needs colour_ref.
